download_wise_dataset: download the WISE dataset from GitHub and process JSON files into a JSONL prompts file
load_wise_prompts: load all WISE prompts from the downloaded JSONL file into a lookup dictionary keyed by id_version
get_wise_prompt_by_id: get a specific WISE prompt by its ID from the downloaded dataset directory
create_wise_lookup_key: create a composite lookup key from a prompt ID and version string for WISE dataset lookups
review_wise_module: review the WISE source module that downloads and processes the PKU-YuanGroup WISE benchmark dataset
